target_only_tests.note: The CPython differential oracle (test/fencing/fnmatch-shlex-oracle.test.ts). Target-only: these translate NO interlock node id and are NOT counted as ported coverage. They exist because src/fencing/fnmatch.ts, shlex.ts, pypath.ts, pyrepr.ts and pyregex.ts are transcriptions of CPython, and a transcription is only checkable against the thing it transcribes -- interlock's suite has nothing to say about behaviour its standard library supplied by construction. See DECISIONS.md D-0200 and docs/differential-oracle.md. They are declared on this ledger rather than the renderer's because they belong to no single ported source file; the choice is bookkeeping, and either ledger would satisfy the check.
